description:
LA' Medics and Diagnostic Center is a healthcare facility located in the heart of Mbarara City, conveniently positioned between **Pelican Hotel** and **Oxford Hotel**. We provide diagnostic and medical care to the people of Mbarara and the wider Western region, and we are committed to delivering friendly, professional and affordable healthcare.

We are looking for a **female enrolled nurse** aged between 23 and 30 years, with at least one year of nursing experience, to join our clinical team.

## About the role

The successful candidate will work within our clinical team to provide quality nursing care to our patients. This is a hands-on clinical role suited to a compassionate and well-organised nurse who enjoys working closely with patients and colleagues in a busy facility.

## Key responsibilities

- Provide quality nursing care to patients attending the centre
- Assist clinicians with patient assessment, procedures and treatments
- Monitor and record patient vital signs and progress
- Maintain accurate patient records and clinical documentation
- Support infection prevention and control practices within the facility
- Keep the consultation and treatment areas clean, safe and organised
- Communicate with patients warmly and clearly in Runyankore-Rukiga

## Qualifications and requirements

- Female, aged between 23 and 30 years
- At least one year of nursing experience
- Certificate or diploma in nursing from a recognised institution
- Must be able to speak and understand Runyankore-Rukiga
- Someone who is already staying in Mbarara is an added advantage

## What we offer

- Monthly salary of UGX 350,000
- A lunch allowance of UGX 5,000

## How to apply

Bring in your application physically to LA' Medics and Diagnostic Center, located between Pelican Hotel and Oxford Hotel, Mbarara City.

The deadline for applications is **21 August 2026**.

LA' Medics and Diagnostic Center is an equal opportunity employer. No money or bribes are required at any stage of the recruitment process. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
